title: Energizing German Skewers with Chickpeas
description: A flavorful German-inspired dish made with energizing ingredients, perfect for a summer evening. Chickpeas add a boost of protein and fiber to this tasty skewer.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together herbal tea, olive oil, and Ethiopian spices.
3. Add the chickpeas to the bowl and toss to coat.
5. Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes, turning frequently.
6. Serve hot with additional Ethiopian spices on the side, if desired.
